description: This file defines a generic class AzureTableStorageStreamFailureHandler that implements IStreamFailureHandler. It handles stream delivery failures by writing failure details to Azure Table Storage, including methods for initialization and failure handling.

classes.name: AzureTableStorageStreamFailureHandler<TEntity>
classes.description: A handler for stream delivery failures that logs failures to Azure Table Storage, parameterized by the entity type TEntity.

methods.name: InitAsync
methods.description: Initializes the Azure Table Storage by creating the table if it does not exist.

methods.name: OnDeliveryFailure
methods.description: Handles a delivery failure event by delegating to OnFailure.

methods.name: OnSubscriptionFailure
methods.description: Handles a subscription failure event by delegating to OnFailure.

methods.name: OnFailure
methods.description: Creates a failure entity with details of the failure and stores it in Azure Table Storage.
